api_library: Project Zomboid vanilla Lua/exposed engine APIs
returns: Base hook has no return value; concrete consumer handlers may consume input. Native ISButton routing remains NOT TESTED.
mutation: Client input callback only; mod handler changes disposable local puzzle state. No gameplay/network/persistence authority.

evidence.statement: Base Lua UI declares the right mouse-up hook with x/y arguments.
Vanilla assigns an instance-specific right mouse-up handler on an initialized UI descendant.

notes: Observed base callback declaration and vanilla assignment to an ISImage descendant. Source evidence does not prove mouse/controller dispatch in the mod or native UI hit testing.
